rls_policy_patterns.note: BACKUP_SCHEMA covers ~70% of tables. Remaining ~400 policies follow these patterns:

critical.title: Plaintext Secrets in Database
critical.recommendation: Move to Supabase Vault or encrypt at app layer

critical.title: FK Semantic Mismatch in ai_settings_* Tables
critical.detail: Column named tenant_id references workspaces(id) not tenants(id)
critical.recommendation: Rename tenant_id to workspace_id in all 8 ai_settings_* tables

high.title: Dual tenant_id/workspace_id Inconsistency
high.detail: Three patterns: workspace_id only (preferred), both required, tenant_id only (legacy)
high.recommendation: Complete tenant_id deprecation, ensure all RLS uses workspace_id

high.title: ~48 Tables with Unverified RLS Status
high.detail: Need live DB query to confirm

medium.title: Overly permissive policy on industry_verticals (USING true)
Missing indexes on workspace_id for cmo_*, cro_*, voice_*, outbound_* tables

low.title: Nullable FKs on leads.tenant_id, deals.tenant_id, deals.lead_id, tasks.deal_id, voice_call_records.*
